main_idea: BAR spans 5,161 legal cases across 28 practice areas.
ideas: Benchmark built from real legal work
summary: The decorative tile grid and slogan headline and tagline clutter a graphic whose counts are clear, and the grid lacks any legend explaining its marks.

missing.why: The tile grid has no legend or scale, so readers cannot tell what each mark stands for.

regions.label: blue
regions.name: Brand and benchmark name
regions.reason: Logo plus benchmark name tell the reader what is measured.

regions.label: blue
regions.name: Case and area counts
regions.reason: The two headline numbers with their unit labels carry the main point.

regions.label: red
regions.name: Slogan headline
regions.reason: Slogan that does not state the finding; the stats already carry the point.

regions.label: orange
regions.name: Decorative tile grid
regions.reason: Count drawn as many repeated marks; the stated numbers alone would do. Marks encode no legible value.

regions.label: red
regions.name: Tagline footer
regions.reason: Tagline restating the benchmark's purpose; adds nothing to the counts.
